LanguageData.LP_LO_Slowed.label: blade wall cut
LanguageData.LP_LO_Slowed.description: Cut by a blade barrier: movement ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_LO_Thrall.label: undead servant
LanguageData.LP_LO_Thrall.description: An undead servant that rose after being killed by finger of death: loyal to the caster's faction, no mental breaks, feels little pain (pain ×0.5).
LanguageData.LP_LO_Regenerating.label: regenerate
LanguageData.LP_LO_Regenerating.description: Regenerative magic flows inside: a lost limb or organ grows back after 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_LO_Levitated.label: reverse gravity
LanguageData.LP_LO_Levitated.description: Thrown into the air by reversed gravity and unable to move; takes blunt damage on landing (severity = damage).
LanguageData.LP_LO_MindBlank.label: mind blank
LanguageData.LP_LO_MindBlank.description: The mind wiped blank: immune to mind control, charm, mental breaks and psychic damage (psychic sensitivity ×0, mind resistance +100%).
LanguageData.LP_LO_BoneBreak.label: bone-breaker strike
LanguageData.LP_LO_BoneBreak.description: The next melee hit breaks one of the target's legs or arms (a heavy blow instead against legendary creatures).
LanguageData.LP_LO_Fracture.label: fracture
LanguageData.LP_LO_Fracture.description: A bone broken by a bone-breaker strike: this part is nearly unusable, healing after 10 days.
LanguageData.LP_LO_Backlash.label: arcanum backlash
LanguageData.LP_LO_Backlash.description: Failed to absorb an arcanum crystal, and the lake's magic surged back: consciousness -30%. Can't absorb arcanum crystals again for 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_LO_Weakened.label: wish weakness
LanguageData.LP_LO_Weakened.description: A great wish drained too much life force: consciousness -20%, movement and work speed ×0.8.
